asr.full_text: This is Shah, and DOGE is once again giving 1 of the cleanest and most repeatable setups in the entire market right now. And if you understand this properly, you don't need to chase trades, the market will literally come to your levels again and again. Right now DOGE is trading around 0.0903 and in the last update we clearly marked the support at 0.090 price respected that level perfectly bounced from it and gave a clean move of around four percent now what makes this even more interesting is that price has once again come back to the same support zone which means the same setup is forming again in real time. Let me ask you something here, when you see a level working multiple times like this do you trust it and build a strategy around it or do you hesitate thinking this time it might fail? Now if we zoom out and look at the higher time frame the story becomes even clearer and this support is not something that formed recently, it has been holding for more than a month. Every single time price drops into this area, buyers step in and push it higher. This is a clear sign of accumulation and strong demand sitting at this level. As long as this support at 0.0 nine zero continues to hold the direction remains simple and that is to the upside there is no need to over complicate the analysis the first target remains at 0.09 five and once that level is reached the next target sits at 0.1 zero three these levels are not random they have been tested multiple times and the market continues to respect them Now here is the most important part that most traders ignore This is not just a one-time reaction price has bounced from this support more than 10 times and every single time the move has been at least 4% to 6%. That Is Consistency. Consistency is what builds profitable strategies over time. In a fearful market where most traders are confused and chasing random moves, having a clean range like this is a huge advantage.
